cases.oracle: Owned UID-2000 task, util-linux setup preflight, direct native sched_setattr without KEEP_POLICY, independent parent readback and fork-child self-read.
cases.comparison: Save per-invocation candidate status/stdout/stderr and independent before/after scheduler data; unsupported guest preflight is ERROR, never FAIL.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/devices-uclamp-observer-r1.py preflight
/bin/mv "$HOME/uclamp-events.json" "$HOME/uclamp-control.json"
/bin/mv "$HOME/uclamp-before.json" "$HOME/uclamp-control-before.json"
cases.purpose: Reset-on-fork with independent direct native control and owned task
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t uclampset) == builtin ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/uclamp-setter-followup.py fork "$BASH"
